project: Product ad - 2 hosts, wide plate, product insert
environment: Warm podcast studio, acoustic panels behind them, two boom microphones on desk arms, soft key light from camera left.

hosts.label: Woman 1
hosts.persona: has a curious, skeptical, slightly amused personality

hosts.label: Woman 2
hosts.persona: knows the subject better but speaks casually, like telling a friend something surprising rather than performing an advertisement

refs.desc: Woman 1 is seated on the left, Woman 2 on the right, exactly as in the close ups.
Keep the label facing camera and fully legible whenever it is in frame.

beats.line: Okay so you've been telling me about this for two weeks and I still don't get it.
Because you keep asking me the wrong question.
beats.reaction: raises an eyebrow and half smiles

beats.line: Not what's in it. How fast you actually feel it, and whether you'd still be taking it a month later.
Fine. How fast do you actually feel it?
Four days. And I know exactly how that sounds, I'm not going to pretend I believed it either when she first told me about it.

beats.reaction: sits back, half laughing, clearly not buying it yet

beats.line: See, that face you're making right now is exactly why I don't trust any of this stuff, and you know that.
I know. I had the same face for about a month.
But this is the one I kept in my bag, and I am not a person who keeps things in her bag.
beats.prop: lifts the bottle off the desk and turns it so the label faces camera

beats.line: Okay hold on, let me actually see that thing properly.
Tight insert on the product sitting on the desk between the two microphones, label fully legible, shallow depth of field, same warm studio light.
Huh. That's a lot smaller than I pictured in my head.
That's kind of the point though. It's two in the morning, that's the whole routine.
And that's it? No powder, no shake, no thirty minute thing?
No. And honestly if it was a thirty minute thing I would have quit in week one like I quit everything else.
Right? But that's why it stuck. The hard part was never the wanting, it was the remembering.

beats.reaction: gives a knowing look, mouth closed, like she is about to land the point
